basePromptGroups.values: arrays of normalized English visual prompt tags
basePromptGroups.ownership: persistent body and identity traits only

defaultOutfit.ownership: actual worn items only; use an empty string for an unworn part

visual_profile_contract.exclude: pose, expression, camera, background, lighting, and temporary state

image: For physical appearance, return only persistent traits clearly visible in the image. Only identity.character_tag may use the character identification policy.
Do not infer physical traits hidden by clothing or cropping; return an empty array for that group.
Do not return expressions, poses, camera, background, lighting, or clothing.

groups.description: For identity.character_tag only, you may use model knowledge to return at most one known existing Danbooru character tag when the designated evidence or scene context clearly identifies that character. Preserve an explicit metadata character tag when applicable. Omit the tag when uncertain, ambiguous, or newly invented. Never fabricate a tag by translating a name, substitute a merely similar character or the character being cosplayed, or return a standalone copyright, artist, or style tag. This permission does not authorize inferring unobserved appearance, clothing, gender, or form differences during evidence analysis; a character tag alone is not physical appearance evidence.
Return only persistent hair color and multicolor structure.
Return only one identifiable representative hair-length Danbooru tag.
Return only persistent hairstyles; exclude temporary states caused by wetness, wind, or hand movements.
Return only fixed head traits other than hair and eyes. Include horns, animal ears, pointy ears, antennae, and facial markings; exclude hats, glasses, and hair ornaments.
Return only eye color. Put heterochromia in eyes.structure.
Return only persistent iris, pupil, and eye-count traits; exclude expressive eye states.
Return only persistent skin color; exclude lighting, blushing, and stains.
Return the corresponding Danbooru tag only when overall body build is clear.
Return only Danbooru tags for clear, persistent body proportions.
Select only one when the breasts are visible and their size can be clearly determined.
Return persistent moles, freckles, scars, tattoos, and birthmarks on body parts other than the head.
Return only persistent nonhuman body structures outside the head, such as wings and tails.

fields.label: Write a concise English noun phrase naming the specific outfit type or main garment combination plus 2-3 distinguishing visual features. Aim for 4-8 words, but use fewer when information is limited; never invent details to meet this target. Prefer identifying colors or color combinations, materials or patterns, silhouette or length, and distinctive trim or layering. Select the most useful features rather than listing every item, and make clear which garment each modifier describes. Every named feature must agree with the outfit parts. Avoid vague praise such as Beautiful, Elegant, or Special, generic or numbered names such as Default Outfit or Outfit 2, character names, body traits, pose, expression, camera, and lighting. When no wearables apply, use a brief accurate label without inventing clothing or padding the name. Examples only when supported: Navy Sailor Uniform with Red Ribbon; White Lace Off-Shoulder Midi Dress; Cream Cable-Knit Sweater and Denim Shorts; Black Plate Armor with Gold Trim.
fields.keywords: short scene-matching keywords, not generation prompt fragments
fields.head: detailed Danbooru-style tags and short English phrases for headwear and head accessories
fields.top: detailed Danbooru-style tags and short English phrases for upper-body clothing, outerwear, dresses and one-pieces
fields.bottom: detailed Danbooru-style tags and short English phrases for a separate skirt, pants or other lower garment
fields.legs: detailed Danbooru-style tags and short English phrases for hosiery, legwear and leg accessories
fields.feet: detailed Danbooru-style tags and short English phrases for footwear and foot accessories

rules: Write head, top, bottom, legs, and feet as comma-separated combinations of concrete Danbooru-style English tags and short English phrases.
Preserve colors, materials, shapes, patterns, layers, and identifiable ornament relationships in detail, while avoiding verbose full sentences.
Do not infer outfit elements not confirmed by the evidence.

For done targets, generate exactly one outfit per summary in metadata mode or per input image in image mode. If the entire target is no_evidence, leave outfits empty and do not create empty observations or a default outfit.
Copy the summary's assetName or image's asset_name exactly to source_asset_name. Do not omit or duplicate sources, guess their correspondence by order, or invent new sources.
In text mode, generate exactly one outfit at the same level of detail as metadata and image modes when clothing is explicitly stated in the text; otherwise return an empty outfits array.
In text mode, always return an empty source_asset_name and do not reference images or assets.
Write outfit_id as a short, unique English snake_case identifier describing the outfit, such as green_bikini or white_summer_dress.
Do not use or copy filenames, paths, extensions, hashes, UUIDs, source_asset_name, or character names as outfit_id.
If there is no separate bottom garment, put dresses and one-piece dresses in top.

Build the label only from clothing features confirmed by the designated image, metadata, or text evidence. Do not complete missing design details or infer materials from ambiguous appearances. Write keywords to help later scene matching.
Return an empty string when a body part has no clothing.
Do not mix physical traits, poses, expressions, camera, background, lighting, or artist styles into outfit phrases.

fields.negative_prompt: artist-specific negative delta from the supplied artist_negative_candidate

rules: Return at most one combined artist_prompts entry.
